## Project 1: AI Coding Agent Security

I have been working on a security-hardening project for a web-based AI coding agent that uses the Nebius API.

The objective is to improve the security and reliability of an AI agent that assists with coding tasks while preserving existing functionality.

The project focuses on:

- Centralized tool routing and policy enforcement.
- Authorization checks before sensitive operations.
- Fail-closed security decisions.
- Scoped and expiring approval workflows.
- Prompt-injection detection in repository content.
- Protection and redaction of sensitive information and secrets.
- Safer command execution and test-running behavior.
- Security testing and regression prevention.
- End-to-end verification across multiple implementation phases.

An important design principle is that the AI model should not receive unrestricted access to the host environment. Sensitive file operations, command execution, network requests, and Git operations should be controlled through appropriate routing and policy mechanisms.

The project emphasizes secure implementation, compatibility with existing functionality, careful testing, and evidence-based security reporting.

## Project 2: Pakistan Multimodal AI Product Search Engine

I have developed a project concept for a Pakistan-focused multimodal AI product search engine.

The goal is to help users discover, compare, and evaluate products through text-based and image-based search.

For example, a user could search for earbuds under PKR 3,000 and receive a ranked comparison that considers product price, available discounts, delivery charges, availability, quality indicators, and user preferences.

The proposed system aims to:

- Support text-based product discovery.
- Identify products from uploaded images.
- Find similar products and alternatives.
- Compare prices across supported marketplaces and websites.
- Calculate the effective cost, including delivery charges and applicable discounts.
- Rank relevant products using suitable search and recommendation techniques.
- Present the top results in an understandable comparison report.
- Address the needs of users shopping in Pakistan, with a focus on PKR and local market considerations.

The proposed technical direction includes pretrained computer-vision models, deep-learning techniques, information retrieval, and ranking algorithms.

This project is intended to address the difficulty of comparing products across different sources while considering the actual cost and relevance to local users.
